 India beat Cameroon at FIFA Under-15 World Cup & Festival    Date :26-Oct-2026 
     BAKU:   
INDIA continued their winning 
run at the inaugural FIFA U-15 
World Cup & Festival Azerbaijan 
2026, defeating Cameroon 2-1 in 
their second Group K match here 
Sunday. 
An own goal by Fareil Ngobo 
(1st) gave the Blue Colts an early lead, but Cameroon equalised 
through Muhammad Sohil 
Khan’s own goal (20th) at the 
stroke of half-time at the Hovsan 
Competition Complex Pitch 1B. 
R Lalremruatfela (27th) 
restored India’s advantage in the 
second half, while goalkeeper 
Jenit Ningthoujam produced a 
series of saves, including a penalty stop, to secure the victory. 
India are now the only team in 
Group K to have won both their 
matches so far.   
Despite the rainy conditions, 
the Blue Colts made an immediate impact. Deepak Singh 
Arambam’s corner in the first 
minute caused confusion in the 
Cameroon box, with Ngobo 
attempting a headed clearance 
that sent the ball into his own 
net. 
India managed the closing 
moments well, holding their 
shape and seeing out the contest to secure a second successive victory. 
India will next face Grenada later on Sunday, before concluding 
the qualification stage against 
Bahrain and Senegal on October 
26. Their results across the five 
matches will determine which 
performance tier they enter for 
the second phase.
